accommodation.notes: Dormitory bed for a Work Permit holder: low is MOM's Q1 2023 median, typical its 2023 median. No newer or higher figure could be read, so high repeats typical. A worker pays what the employer deducts (at most 25% of salary). A live-in domestic worker pays 0: MOM puts housing on the employer.

source.publisher: Ministry of Manpower (Singapore), parliamentary reply of 5 February 2024

other_sources.publisher: Ministry of Manpower (Singapore), parliamentary reply of 2 August 2023
Ministry of Manpower (Singapore), paying a migrant domestic worker's salary

food.notes: Catered meals in a dormitory, the monthly range TWC2 reported in 2023; typical is the midpoint. A worker who buys all their own meals is not covered. A live-in domestic worker pays 0: MOM puts meals on the employer.

source.publisher: Transient Workers Count Too (TWC2), article of 7 May 2023

other_sources.publisher: Ministry of Manpower (Singapore), paying a migrant domestic worker's salary

transport.notes: Adult card fares on the PTC table (1.28 to 2.57 a journey) times 52 journeys (2 a day for 26 working days, assumed); typical is the midpoint. The monthly travel pass is for citizens and PRs only, so it is not used.

source.publisher: Public Transport Council (Singapore), page last updated 28 January 2026

phone_data.notes: 30-day prepaid plans on SIMBA's page: 10 is its cheapest adult plan, 12 the one it labels Most Popular (a marketing label), 20 a plan with 800 call minutes. Singtel's hi! plans start at 15.

mandatory_deductions.notes: No CPF for foreign workers. Housing, food and transport deductions need the worker's written consent and sit in their own lines; levy, bonds and medical fees can never be deducted. Income tax was not checked.

source.publisher: Ministry of Manpower (Singapore), paying a foreign worker's salary

transport_card.notes: SimplyGo EZ-Link adult card at a ticket office: 5 card cost plus 5 stored value, which the worker then spends on rides.

sim_card.notes: Singtel hi! plans: collecting the SIM is free. The first 30-day plan is counted in phone_data.
